items.title: Jesse Miettinen Released Damage Control, Powerful New Blender Toolkit
items.excerpt: Jesse Miettinen has launched Damage Control, a Blender toolkit of interconnected generative tools (Smudge Mask Generator, Scatter Tools, Generative Tools, plus shaders and Mega Presets) to help artists scatter, smudge, and procedurally build more lifelike game environments faster.

items.title: "It creates lesser games": Indie game studios are supposed to love generative AI, so why do the 25 devs I spoke to avoid it?
items.excerpt: A reporter interviews 25 indie studios about why they avoid generative AI despite it being pitched as an indie accelerator, surfacing how AI actually fits (or fails to fit) into working game-design craft and production workflows.

items.title: Half of all games released on Steam will use AI by 2028, study predicts: "AI lowers the barrier not just to make a game but to make several"
items.excerpt: A study of ~53,600 Steam releases projects generative AI will feature in roughly half of all Steam games by 2028, arguing AI lowers the barrier not just to make a game but to make several — a shift reshaping how small teams produce and ship content.

items.title: How to Build Scalable MetaHuman Crowds in Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
items.excerpt: An Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 session on building scalable MetaHuman crowds in Unreal Engine with Mass and Nanite — a production pipeline for populating game worlds with AI-authored digital-human characters at scale.
